# [STORY] As a developer, I want major frontend dependencies upgraded to current versions, so that the app runs on a supported, modern stack

## User Story
**As a** developer
**I want** React, react-router-dom, RTK, and MUI upgraded to their current major versions
**So that** the app uses supported APIs and we stop accumulating upgrade debt

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given the upgrade is applied, when `npm ls react` is run, then React 19.x is installed and `ReactDOM.render` is replaced with `createRoot`. — done via #128.
- [x] Given the upgrade is applied, when `npm ls react-router-dom` is run, then v7.x is installed and all route definitions use the v7 API. — done via #129 (`react-router-dom@7.18.2`, `Switch`→`Routes`, `Redirect`→`Navigate`, `useHistory`→`useNavigate`).
- [x] Given the upgrade is applied, when `npm ls @reduxjs/toolkit` is run, then RTK 2.x is installed with no deprecation warnings. — done via #130 (`2.12.0`).
- [x] Given the upgrade is applied, when `npm ls @mui/material` is run, then MUI 6.x is installed and all usages compile without deprecation warnings. — done via #130 (`6.5.0`).
- [x] Given the upgraded app, when `npm run build` is executed, then the production bundle compiles with 0 errors. — verified clean.

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 8

## Definition of Done
- [x] Meets [Definition of Done](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md), with one standing exception carried by design, not overlooked: the repo-wide `npm audit` gate stays red (2 moderate + 1 high, both from `vite`/`@codemod/cli`'s `esbuild` dev-server dependency, pre-existing before this Story). That's explicitly Story #124's whole point ("audit-clean and CI-green"), not one of this Story's own acceptance criteria above — tracked there, not re-litigated here.

## Notes
All three Technical Tasks are complete. React is on 19.x with `createRoot`
(#128), react-router-dom is on 7.x with the v6+ API (#129), and RTK
2.12.0 / MUI 6.5.0 are installed with no deprecation warnings and a clean
production build (#130). #130 also had to remove `@mui/styles` (replaced
with `tss-react/mui`) since it has no React-19-compatible release and was
blocking installs outright — not in this Story's literal AC text, but
required to actually reach it.
